headline: BoC's Macklem tells MPs growth will slow in Q4 on new US tariffs, repeating the October forecast of 1% GDP growth in 2026
why: Nothing new: these are the Bank of Canada's October 28 forecasts, given again in testimony to Parliament. The BoC raised rates to 2.5% then. The CAD may move only if he hints at December policy.
india: Little direct effect on India. The remarks about high oil and refinery margins match the pressure on India's import bill and the rupee, but they add nothing new.
watch_next: Macklem's Q&A for hints of a December rate hike, and the next Canadian CPI data.

impact.why: Repeats the known outlook: hawkish on inflation, softer on Q4 growth. Little new for the CAD.
